note: Every control a player has, in the Game Bible. The controls check (qa/controls-check.mjs) fails the build when a control listed here has no passing real-input result on a track the game ships. Ids are what each track's input test reports. Only a person changes this list (2.32.0: it is a protected file). 2.39.0: an effect says what a control must change in the sim state (path + up|down|changes|same|a number), measured from just before the real press to just after it (its wait), so pick a value only that control moves in that time; the browser check tests it, so the game's own test can't be the only judge.
